jobs_results.title: Marketing Executive
jobs_results.description:
Department: Sales & Marketing


Designation: Sales & Marketing Executive / Officer


Location: Baramati / Pune
Industry: Furniture / Sofa Manufacturing


Job Purpose To generate new business opportunities, develop customer relationships, achieve sales targets, and promote the company's furniture products in the market.


Key Responsibilities
 Identify and develop new customers, dealers, distributors, retailers and business opportunities. Visit customers, dealers, furniture shops, interior designers and project sites for business development. Generate leads through market visits, references, online platforms and other sources. Explain company products, features, pricing and offers to customers. Prepare quotations and negotiate prices and commercial terms with customers. Follow up with prospective customers and convert leads into sales. Achieve monthly and yearly sales targets. Maintain good relationships with existing customers and ensure repeat business. Coordinate with the Production, Design, Dispatch and Accounts departments for order execution. Monitor competitor products, pricing and market trends. Collect customer feedback and communicate it to the management. Maintain daily sales visit reports, lead details, customer database and sales records. Follow up on pending payments in coordination with the Accounts Department. Participate in exhibitions, dealer meetings and promotional activities. Support digital marketing activities such as WhatsApp, social media and online product promotion.  Qualification
 Graduate in any discipline. MBA/PGDM in Marketing/Sales will be an added advantage.  Experience
 13 years of experience in Sales & Marketing preferred. Experience in Furniture / Sofa / Interior / Building Material / Home Dcor industry will be an advantage. Freshers with good communication and sales skills may also be considered.  Required Skills
 Good communication and negotiation skills. Customer handling and relationship management. Strong follow-up and convincing ability. Knowledge of local market and customer network. Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel. Ability to achieve sales targets. Willingness to travel for customer visits. Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.  Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
 Monthly sales achievement. Number of new customers/dealers generated. Number of qualified leads. Lead-to-order conversion ratio. Customer retention and repeat orders. Collection/payment follow-up. Number of market/customer visits. New market/dealer development.  Salary
As per candidate's experience and skills.


Preferred candidate profile

jobs_results.title: Online Marketer
jobs_results.description:
Online Marketer jobs in Delhi at CryptoMize are open on a rolling, always-hiring basis — we staff channel capacity ahead of the next campaign surge, not after the brief lands. This is a full-time, permanent Online Marketer position with immediate joining, based at our New Delhi HQ, sitting inside the marketing cell that runs paid acquisition, content distribution, and channel-test cycles for sovereign, political, and enterprise clients across 18 countries. Below is the complete Online Marketer job description: the responsibilities you will own from day one, the requirements, the seniority path, and the selection process. Marketers who want their budget to mean something — campaigns that moved real engagement, channels that fed real client decisions — should read to the end.



 LOCATION New Delhi (HQ)
 EMPLOYMENT Full-time · Permanent
 AVAILABILITY Immediate · Rolling intake
 COMPENSATION Discussed at screening
TRACKS ON THIS DESK33
CRAFT SKILLS NAMED11
TOOLS & SYSTEMS5
PATH STAGES4

01
01The actual work


What will you actually do as a Online Marketer at CryptoMize?
01
Own paid acquisition across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and programmatic channels for live engagement campaigns — full budget authority at the small-to-mid five-figure monthly range


02
Set and enforce channel-discipline standards — naming conventions, UTM discipline, attribution models — that every cell consumes


03
Design the channel-mix architecture for new engagements alongside the engagement strategist — channel selection, audience seeding, budget allocation


04
Lead the A/B test program across channel, creative, and audience variables; sign off on test reads before they reach the client


05
The online marketer review cycle examines multiplier output for Online Marketer seats — in every review packet


06
Sit in client briefings as the channel authority — when a client asks "where is the spend going, and what is it doing," you answer, with the dashboard, the lift, and the next plan


07
Work at the channel center of an operation whose campaigns run on real engagement budgets for sovereign clients: every rupee you spend, every conversion you attribute, becomes part of why engagements grow


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES


As an Online Marketer at CryptoMize you will own paid acquisition and content distribution for live engagement campaigns — running the channel mix, the A/B test program, and the weekly reporting rhythm that strategists and clients both consume. The role applies disciplined attribution architecture before any spend reaches a channel, because unattributed spend is the fastest way to lose a client.


Quality assurance is a standing duty rather than an occasional task: most agencies discover channel problems when the budget is already gone, but here marketers intercept them upstream — in the UTM discipline, the audience seed review, the pacing dashboard. You will maintain the reporting rhythm that lets any channel decision be reconstructed and explained, on demand, in front of a client.


Marketers here also carry institutional responsibility for the intern program: supervising scoped channel projects, reviewing their reports, and feeding intern conversion decisions. The marketers who teach well are the ones we promote first, because the cell grows only as fast as its teaching culture.

03Seniority ladder


Online Marketer — seniority path at CryptoMize
Marketers advance by the campaigns that ship and the lift they generate, not tenure. The ladder below is how the marketing cell is actually organized.
